R8 = 0: no noise or disturbance in the validation. T_BENCH = 0: 'benchmark' names a textbook two-link model, not a named benchmark or injection protocol. E8-c2b (literal A1/A2 reading, author decision 25-11; full text, Sec. 3, eqs. (15)-(23)): A1 -> A2; estimated online: d-hat_t, adaptive estimate of sigma-hat = rho^-1 sigma (the scaled additive actuator fault); K2 adapts to the effectiveness loss.

fault_equation: LIE: theta_k = eta_k u_k; LIP: theta_j = theta_bar_j for t >= t_j; unified input vartheta with diagonal eta and theta matrices (redundant inputs)
normal_form_fit: full: lambda_i = eta_k (F1); s_i = 1 with tau_bar = theta_bar (F4t)
fault_magnitude: actuator 1: 22 % efficiency loss, vartheta_1 = 0.78 u_1 for t > 6 s; actuator 2 locked at a constant output (value NR in extracted text)
mechanism: reinforcement-learning identifier-critic-actor (fuzzy approximators) optimal backstepping with predefined-time prescribed performance for Ito stochastic nonlinear systems
structural_condition: actuation redundancy (some actuators may lock while others remain)
platform: numerical simulation of a single-link arm with BDC motor dynamics and stochastic disturbances
baselines: AFTC (refs. 17, 30), predefined-time FTC (ref. 22), finite-time FTC (refs. 39, 43)
metric: convergence (settling) time and cost functions; Table II convergence time and control input (values not captured); about 25-30 % lower cost (approximate remark)
repetitions: single run per case (stochastic noise, no statistics)
notes: Read through USACH institutional access (IEEE Xplore). Generic stochastic nonlinear systems with the single-link BDC arm as validation benchmark. A4 primary: in the identifier-critic-actor structure the identifier FLS approximates the unknown dynamics (Sec. III-A, Eqs. (37)-(38)) and the actor FLS gives the optimal virtual controllers and the actual fault-tolerant control (Eqs. (41)-(42), (56), (68)), so the learned policy is the control action. R00218 differs (A1 since RS5b): its actor NN approximates the unknown dynamics inside a sliding-mode law (Sec. III-B.2, Eqs. (36)-(38)). R2 = 1 on the 0.78 effectiveness value; locked value not captured. R6 = 1 on Table II (convergence time, faulty case), values not captured. No fault-free run reported (R5 = 0). RS5b adjudication (24-11-2026) against the full text: R5 0 -> 1.
